# Data Directory

Auto-populated by the pipeline (`pipeline/build_rs_data.py`).

* Production: GitHub Actions cron (`.github/workflows/refresh-data.yml`) rebuilds every JSON file here each weekday morning.
* On first repo clone, the files may contain SAMPLE/synthetic data generated by `pipeline/gen_sample_data.py` -- overwritten by the first real cron run.

Check `meta.json` -> `sources.prices` to see which source produced the current data.
